Help/Reviewing and sharing/Pause or turn off

Pause or turn off sharing

Pause keeps the same link for later. Turn off ends the link for good. Both are under Manage sharing on the walkthrough’s card in your account.

Pause sharing
Within a minute, the link, embed and QR code show "not available". The link stays the same, so printed QR codes work again when you resume.
Resume sharing
Within a minute, the same link, embed and QR code open the walkthrough again.
Turn off sharing
Stops the link, its embed and any printed QR code for good. You confirm it first. Turning sharing back on makes a new link, and copies someone already downloaded cannot be recalled.
  1. Open your Veylet account and find the walkthrough’s card.
  2. Open Manage sharing.
  3. Choose Pause sharing for a break, or Turn off sharing to end the link.

If it doesn’t work

After turning sharing off, remove the old link and embed from your listing and website too.

Changes reach viewers within a minute. If a page still shows the walkthrough, reload it.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to yoda@yodalai.xyz and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
